boundedQuestion: Does the current private Vehicle checkpoint contain a runnable, manifest-pinned WebGPU compute route rather than only CPU/mock evidence?

evidence.gpuExperimentScope: self-authored plane/biquadratic fixtures only; current vehicle bundles unsupported
evidence.ownerAndIndependentSuites: CPU/fail-closed and CPU/mock only; no packaged shader compilation or GPU execution

checks.name: GPU host entry is present and pinned
GPU host declares a relative shader fetch
referenced WGSL shader is absent from manifest
GPU README says real shader execution was not run
GPU README limits scope away from current car bundles
current preview explicitly paints CPU Canvas2D
owner test can stop before shader fetch
independent mock replaces fetch and does not load packaged WGSL
independent review records a shader hash not delivered by checkpoint

interpretation: The package preserves genuine function-geometry and CPU-renderer work, but its delivered WebGPU experiment is not executable because a transitive shader resource is absent. Manifest hash verification proves captured-byte integrity, not executable dependency closure.
candidateGate: Before a delivery may claim a runnable route, every statically referenced runtime resource must exist, be manifest-pinned, and be exercised without a mock that replaces the resource load.
